{{Quote|On this planet things are what Hay-Zu says they are!|Hay-Zu|<ref name=":0" />}}'''Hay-Zu''', self-stylized as '''the Big Hay-Zu''', was an overlord of the [[Patitite/Legends|Patitite]] people. He was rather obese for his [[Species/Legends|species]], being carried by four Patitites on a throne to show power and vanity. He ruled over the people in a manner that made them hate him. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was praised for accidentally crushing him to [[Death/Legends|death]] with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

==Biography==

===Ealy life===
Hay-Zu was a corpulent [[Patitite/Legends|Patitite]] who ruled over his [[Planet/Legends|homeplanet]] during the early years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref> The Big Hay-Zu did not let his diminutive size contain his ego or sense of entitlement. Indeed, the portly Patitite was a giant among his kind, ruling with the tiniest iron fist.<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|hayzu|Hay-Zu}}</ref> He was usually transported over his chariot, pulled by four Patitites.<ref name=":0" />

His high-pitched word was law<ref name=":2">{{SWE|groups|patitites|Patitites}}</ref> and his [[Patitite/Legends|Patitites]], who lived in fear of his booming orders,<ref name=":1" /> captured any trespassers to their territory and brought them before Hay-Zu to be judged.<ref name=":2" /> He sent some of his subjects' [[Youngling/Legends|children]] to fight in his wars, and these were considered to be the lucky ones by the Patitites.<ref name=":0" />

===Death===
{{Quote|What's this? Your friend challenges the Big Hay-Zu's authority?|Hay-Zu becomes angry|<ref name=":0" />}}
[[File:Squishsquash.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Whta remained of Hay-Zu after he was squashed by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref>{{TCWdates|406}}</ref> Hay-Zu was summoned when the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had crash-landed in [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] following a [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|battle]], were captured and brougth to him. He told them to leave immediately while he was in a 'good mood'. C-3PO was happy to leave, but R2 was not intimidated by Hay-Zu,<ref name=":0" /> as he had little patience for the posturing of the puny potentate.<ref name=":1" /> He confronted him, willing to take him on<ref name=":0" /> and showing how small he truly was.<ref name=":1" /> In an attempt to prevent any trouble breaking for the both of them, C-3PO was going to shut R2 off, but accidentally pushed him instead, causing R2 to fall on Hay-Zu, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name=":0" /> A green spoch was all that was left of Hay-Zu,<ref name=":4">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> a [[Color/Legends|colored]] shape over the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] hull.<ref name=":3" />

===Legacy===
The Patitites, however, were overjoyed by this new-found freedom and began worshiping C-3PO. The Patitites then asked C-3PO to be their new leader. He refused and instead helped them establish their [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] and elect their new leader. As the droids left, fighting broke out amongst them pertaining to who would be the leader,<ref name=":0" /> erupting in civil war<ref name=":3" /> that undoubtedly doomed their society to generations of turmoil and strife.<ref name=":2" />

As every [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] culture agreed that squashing a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]'s ruler was a breach of etiquette, sometimes [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3P0]] wished he could have his memory erased,<ref name=":4" /> a wish that he would be granted<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> a [[19 BBY/Legends|year later]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hay-Zu was created for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and appeared in the episode "[[Nomad Droids]]." He was voiced by [[Kevin Michael Richardson]], who also voiced a number of other characters in the television series.<ref name=":0" /> Concept art of Hay-Zu and the other Patitites was produced by artist [[Randy Bantog]].<ref name=":3">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep406|text="Nomad Droids" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
